baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated يَرِثُ predicates one heir first of the speaker and then of آل يعقوب.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repetition stages two source-to-successor transfers, while آل supplies a relational house whose members return to one another. The requested heir is therefore a convergence point for a personal legacy and a wider house-line legacy.

activation_trace.role: Inheritance moving from predecessor to heir; the repeated focus verbs organize two transfers into one successor.
A man's household and those who return to him; it makes the second source a relational house rather than an unspecified estate.

changed_reading.before: A child is requested to receive an inheritance.
changed_reading.after: The child is positioned to join the petitioner's personal legacy to the continuing legacy of Jacob's house.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَٱجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا asks not only for an heir but for his effected quality.
baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative of making, addressed to the Lord as one who nurtures and completes, makes fitness part of succession. رَضِيًّا can carry acceptance together with obedience, love, or guarantor-like reliability, so the successor must be formed for a relation, not merely produced.

activation_trace.role: Making a person into a condition or rank; it treats the heir's fitness as an effected qualification.
Repair, nurture, and completion; the vocative locates the successor's formation in sustained divine cultivation.
The radiyy as obedient, loving, or guarantor; it opens 'pleasing' toward relational trustworthiness.

changed_reading.before: The requested child is simply wished to be pleasing.
changed_reading.after: The requested heir must be actively formed into an accepted and trustworthy bearer of what he inherits.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mercy-to-servant frame, fear concerning the mawali, a barren wife, and the request for a gifted wali revise inheritance from passive receipt into divinely supplied continuity of service and guardianship across a blocked biological line.

activation_trace.role: Predecessor-to-heir transfer supplies the succession structure that the context functionally specifies.
Humble worship and obedience; it frames the threatened continuity as service before possession.
Taking charge of an affair and guarding it; the repeated mawali/wali root supplies the office-bearing role sought from the heir.
Cessation of offspring; it supplies the biological break that ordinary succession cannot cross.
A gift given without exchange; it makes the bridge across that break a bestowed provision.

structural_cues: 19:2 presents the episode as remembrance of the Lord's mercy to His servant.
19:5 contrasts feared mawali after the speaker and a barren wife with the imperative to gift a wali from the divine presence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies service, feared successor-relations, barrenness, and gift; I infer that the heir is meant to carry a threatened charge across failed ordinary succession. Alternatively, the concern may remain primarily familial or material.

changed_reading.before: The heir combines two inherited estates or legacies.
changed_reading.after: The heir is a divinely gifted guardian who carries a service-bound legacy through a biological discontinuity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promised boy has no prior namesake, and the answer invokes creation before prior thinghood. Succession thus preserves a line by producing a genuinely new bearer rather than a replica of predecessors.

activation_trace.role: The relational house supplies the continuity within which the successor's novelty must operate.
Bringing something into being; the repeated making-root links the focus request to the absence of a prior counterpart.
A name as designation and public indication; the unique name marks non-duplicative identity within succession.
What precedes or comes forward; its negated prior horizon makes the named successor unprecedented.
Creative origination; the comparison supplies novelty as the means by which an impossible continuity can occur.

structural_cues: 19:7 says no namesake was made for him before.
19:9 answers impossibility by recalling the petitioner's creation when he had not been a thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unprecedented naming and a creation-from-nonbeing comparison; I infer that lineage continuity can proceed through novelty rather than replication. Alternatively, the uniqueness may concern only the name and the creation comparison only biological possibility.

changed_reading.before: Inheritance chiefly repeats and preserves an existing line.
changed_reading.after: The line continues through an unprecedented identity whose newness is itself the divinely made vehicle of continuity.

context_deltas.mechanism: A requested sign becomes suspended speech, followed by gesture that coordinates communal glorification. If the focus inheritance includes knowledge or virtue, this sequence allows transmission to be enacted through signs and patterned practice rather than ordinary speech alone.

activation_trace.role: Inheritance of knowledge, scripture, or virtue supplies the focus-side possibility of a transmissible nonmaterial legacy.
A visible sign; it replaces ordinary explanation with a marked event that can carry meaning.
Intelligible speech linking speakers; its temporary negation identifies the normal channel that is blocked.
Gesture and indication; it supplies the alternate channel by which instruction reaches the group.
Glorification and worship; it is the communal practice successfully transmitted through the gesture.

structural_cues: 19:10 makes not speaking to people for three nights the sign.
19:11 follows his exit to the people with gestural communication and a morning-evening worship command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blocked speech, sign, gesture, and coordinated worship; I infer that a religious legacy can pass through embodied pattern as well as words. Alternatively, this is only a temporary confirmation sign and says nothing about the heir's later inheritance.

changed_reading.before: A nonmaterial inheritance would be teachings verbally handed to the heir.
changed_reading.after: The legacy can also be sign-borne and enacted, preserving communal practice even when ordinary speech is unavailable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The boy is commanded to take the Book with gathered strength and is given judgment or right knowledge while still a child. This sequence strongly selects the focus branch of inherited scripture, knowledge, and virtue and gives it an active, accountable form.

activation_trace.role: Inheritance of knowledge, Book, or virtue supplies the latent focus model that the later sequence activates.
Taking and possessing; it makes reception of the inherited charge active rather than automatic.
Joined letters and the written object; it identifies the Book as a concrete nonmaterial estate.
Strength gathered like strands of a rope; it defines the mode in which the Book must be held.
Giving or bestowal; it presents the successor's competence as granted.
Judgment between people; it adds an authority-bearing dimension to the inherited charge.
Wisdom and right knowledge; it preserves the epistemic reading alongside judicial authority.
Childhood; it shows the transfer taking effect before ordinary maturity.

structural_cues: 19:12 addresses the promised child by name, commands him to take the Book with strength, and reports that judgment was given to him as a boy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same child, Book-taking, strength, bestowal, and childhood judgment; I infer that these instantiate the requested inheritance. Alternatively, familial or material inheritance can coexist and need not be displaced.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge or virtue is only one possible content of the inheritance.
changed_reading.after: The inheritance centrally includes a binding Book and bestowed discernment or authority that the young successor must actively take up.

context_deltas.mechanism: Compassion, purity, and filial good, together with explicit denials of coercive domination and disobedience, concretize رَضِيًّا as relational fitness. Acceptable succession is ethical conduct under authority, not merely being personally liked.

activation_trace.role: The radiyy as obedient, loving, or guarantor supplies the relational range that the later conduct specifies.
Tender mercy and compassion; it gives acceptable authority an affective posture.
Purity and soundness; it makes the successor's fitness inward as well as social.
Filial connection and beneficence opposed to severance; it locates acceptability in conduct toward parents.
Coercive domination; the explicit negation excludes this mode from the successor's authority.
Departure from obedience; its explicit negation bounds the successor's freedom by faithful response.

structural_cues: 19:13-14 continue predicating qualities of the promised child.
The final pair in 19:14 is explicitly negated: he was neither coercive nor disobedient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies positive dispositions and negated failures in the same child's portrait; I infer that they unpack the requested radiyyan and govern how inherited authority is borne. Alternatively, they may be biographical outcomes rather than a direct gloss on the focus adjective.

changed_reading.before: Radiyyan means a generally pleasing or accepted heir.
changed_reading.after: Radiyyan names a compassionate, sound, filial, non-coercive, and obedient fitness for carrying inherited authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The successor himself is placed under peace at birth, death, and raising. Inheritance therefore does not cancel mortality; it appoints one finite custodian in a continuity whose final preservation and reanimation lie beyond hereditary transfer.

activation_trace.role: Transfer from a predecessor to an heir supplies the mortal handoff that the later life-cycle sequence limits.
Safety from harm; it places protection over each boundary rather than promising escape from boundaries.
The event of birth supplies the successor's entry into finite custodianship.
Loss of life and force supplies the limit that also reaches the heir.
Stirring the still from repose; it locates restored continuity in divine reanimation rather than lineage alone.

structural_cues: 19:15 repeats 'day' across the same child's birth, death, and being raised alive, placing peace over all three transitions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the heir's complete mortal arc and raising; I infer that hereditary continuity is finite stewardship rather than immortality. Alternatively, the triad may simply honor the child without qualifying the petition's succession logic.

changed_reading.before: An heir appears to solve the petitioner's mortality by extending his line.
changed_reading.after: The heir is himself a finite bearer; hereditary handoff matters, but ultimate continuity depends on protection and raising beyond the lineage.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a rare fire branch of ورث and a latent-fire branch of وراء across the aging imagery. It remains anchored in the repeated focus يَرِثُ and is reinforced by the head's اشتعل, but downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy, not replace the ordinary sense of inheritance with fire.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus repeats يَرِثُ, whose inventory includes stirring embers until they ignite.

activation_trace.role: Stirring embers into flame; it supplies a focus-side image of legacy as rekindling.
Weakening force and resolve; it supplies the failing bodily medium from which renewal is sought.
Whiteness igniting through the head; it makes aging itself appear as a transformed or spent flame.
Latent fire emerging from a flint; it contributes hidden generative potential behind the apparent succession barrier.

changed_reading.before: The heir receives the legacy of a fading predecessor.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the heir is the spark that rekindles a lineage as the petitioner's embodied fire turns to grey.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a reversal inside the جبر inventory: the surface negates the coercive jabbār, while another branch means mending fracture. It stays anchored to the focus request that the Lord form a radiyy successor, but downstream prose should present repair-instead-of-compulsion as an exploratory role image, not as the lexical meaning of the negated adjective.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus asks the nurturing and completing Lord to make the heir radiyyan.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion; it supplies the focus-side formative vocation.
Obedient, loving, or guarantor-like reliability; it anchors repair in acceptable relationship.
Mending fracture and deficiency; it supplies the exploratory constructive opposite within the same root field.
Coercion and compulsion; the verse explicitly negates this branch and thereby contains the repair image as non-dominating.

changed_reading.before: The acceptable heir is simply not a tyrant.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, his inherited vocation is to mend what is broken precisely by refusing coercive power.

strongest_changes: Inheritance becomes divinely gifted guardianship of a service-bound legacy across a blocked biological line.
The Book and childhood gift of judgment strongly activate inheritance of knowledge and accountable authority.
Radiyyan becomes relational fitness expressed by compassion, soundness, filial good, and refusal of coercion and disobedience.
Unprecedented naming and creation logic allow continuity through novelty rather than replication.
summary.what_was_special: The repeated focus verbs support dual-source succession, while the packet's branch structure lets guardianship, Book and judgment, sign-borne practice, finite custodianship, ember-rekindling, and non-coercive repair remain distinct rather than collapse into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Material or familial inheritance remains live beside service, knowledge, and authority.
The unique-name and creation comparison may address identity and possibility without directly defining the inherited vocation.
The sign-transmission model and both outliers depend on cross-domain activation and need explicit exploratory qualification.
The guarantor-like range of radiyyan is branch-supported but need not dominate its ordinary acceptance sense.
